title: Teacher English Placement detailed CEFR rubrics
notice: Objective sections are scored automatically. Writing and Speaking are scored by an administrator using four 1–4 criteria (maximum 16).

bandScale.overall: Writing and Speaking: 4–6 = A1, 7–9 = A2, 10–13 = B1, 14–16 = B2.

criteria.name: Task Achievement
criteria.description: How fully the response addresses the task, presents a clear position, and develops relevant ideas with support.

criteria.name: Organization
criteria.description: How logically ideas are organized and how effectively paragraphs, referencing, and linking devices guide the reader.

criteria.name: Lexical Resource
criteria.description: The range, accuracy, appropriacy, and flexibility of vocabulary used to express meaning.

criteria.name: Grammatical Range and Accuracy
criteria.description: The variety and accuracy of sentence structures, grammar forms, punctuation, and error control.

writing.weight: Administrator scores each criterion from 1 (A1) to 4 (B2).
writing.reviewNote: Writing is not automatically scored; total the four evaluator scores to determine the CEFR level.

criteria.name: Fluency
criteria.description: How continuously and logically the speaker communicates, including pace, hesitation, and connected ideas.

criteria.name: Vocabulary
criteria.description: The range, precision, flexibility, and appropriacy of vocabulary used in spoken responses.

criteria.name: Grammar
criteria.description: The variety and accuracy of spoken sentence structures and grammar forms.

criteria.name: Communication
criteria.description: How clearly ideas are understood, supported, and developed in the conversation.

speaking.weight: Administrator scores each criterion from 1 (A1) to 4 (B2).
speaking.reviewNote: Speaking is not automatically scored; total the four evaluator scores to determine the CEFR level.
